patterns.note: Sections are full-width with content constrained to a central column, often employing a split layout with text on one side and an image or illustration on the other.
Distinct, solid background colors are used for different sections to visually segment content blocks and create a clear flow down the page.
A persistent, sticky navigation bar remains fixed at the top of the viewport without any visual transformation as the user scrolls.
Feature lists are presented in a three-column card layout, each with a simple icon, a bold title, and a concise descriptive paragraph.

technique_notes: The site uses a sticky header navigation that remains fixed at the top of the viewport, maintaining its initial background color and text styling without any shrinking or transparency changes as the user scrolls down the page.

Content sections are revealed by standard vertical scrolling, with no observed scroll-triggered animations such as fade-ins, slide-ups, or parallax effects for individual elements or entire content blocks.

design_tokens.type_scale: Large, bold sans-serif headings (hero ~3-4x body) with clear hierarchy, complemented by smaller, readable body text.
design_tokens.radius: Subtle (input fields, buttons, and cards have slightly rounded corners).
design_tokens.spacing: Balanced (sections have generous vertical padding, content within sections is well-spaced, not overly dense or airy).

standout: The site effectively uses a vibrant, consistent color palette to segment content and maintain a fresh, approachable feel, contrasting with the often dry subject matter of domain/email services. The combination of a realistic hero image with flat, friendly illustrations also adds a distinctive touch.
